thread:
maya: Heads up — planning to onboard mosaic-7b-v2 into the model catalog tonight. Target deploy window 22:00–22:30 UTC. Who can own the rollout + smoke checks?

samir: I can own rollout + smoke. Will do a canary on the dedicated pool first (5% traffic for 15m). ETA start ~22:05 UTC. @jack can you be ready to trigger rollback? :+1:

jack: yep, I'll be on standby. For rollback we'll pin back to mosaic-7b-v1 and shift traffic. Need exact model IDs and the quick rollback command.

samir: model ids: mosaic-7b-v2 -> model:mosaic/7b:v2, mosaic-7b-v1 -> model:mosaic/7b:v1. Quick pin command I use locally: 
```bash
redwood catalog pin --model model:mosaic/7b --version v1
redwood catalog set-traffic --model model:mosaic/7b --weights v1=100,v2=0
```

elena: smoke checklist (short):
- run 10 concurrent /generate requests (sample prompts)
- run 50 embedding calls on a seed set
- check P50/P95 latency vs baseline (<15% regression)
- check top-1 output correctness on 20 eval prompts
- ensure KV cache warm-up is happening (no huge cold-starts)
If any step fails, roll back.

ci-bot: preflight tests passed — unit/integration/infra checks (8/8 green). No schema breaks detected.

samir: starting canary at 22:05 UTC -> job deploy-8822. Plan: 5% traffic 15m, inspect errors & latency, then 25% for 10m if OK, then 100% promote. Rollback triggers: error rate >1% sustained or P95 > baseline +200ms. Streaming logs to the channel.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job #deploy-8822 for mosaic-7b-v2 canary at 2026-02-17T22:05:00Z. Runner: dedicated-pool-3.

jack: acknowledged. I'll hold the rollback playbook. Quick rollback steps pinned here for reference: 
1) run `redwood catalog set-traffic --model model:mosaic/7b --weights v1=100,v2=0`
2) if promote was partial, revert routing rules in gateway: `gw patch route mosaic-7b --backend v1`
3) notify infra slack and reopen ticket if side-effects.

maya: also please pin a temporary metadata tag on v2 as "canary-2026-02-17" and attach eval-run id #443 so we can trace quality. After canary, paste the eval summary here before full promote.

samir: canary started. Running first perf sweep now. Will report back in ~10m with P50/P95 and error counts.

maya: thanks all — ping if you need extra hands. I'll update the catalog entry post-promote. :thumbsup:
